deadline.value: No fixed deadline; the department processes complete applications in about 1-2 weeks.
deadline.quote: There is no specific deadline for the applications.

gre_general.quote: Q8. Is GRE required? A. No.

fee_waiver.value: The department says it cannot waive the application fee.
fee_waiver.quote: Q5. Can you waive application fee? A. No.

supervisor.value: Finding a faculty member before applying is strongly advised, and the PhD program is near capacity.
supervisor.quote: It is strongly recommended for PhD applicants to find a faculty from the department willing to work with them before applying to the PhD program.

funding.value: Teaching assistantships go to selected applicants; others may seek research assistantships from faculty.
funding.quote: The department selects excellent applicants to give them teaching assistantships (TA).

entry_route.value: The fetched department pages do not state which degree is needed to enter the PhD.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: As of Spring 2026 the department is almost at PhD capacity; new PhD applicants may be denied.
